name: Copperdale
blurb: Once renowned for its booming mining industry, the town of Copperdale, quaint and historic, lay nestled on the banks of Lake LaSuli. With academics and adventures abound, Copperdale is now home to many families seeking a small-town life with big-city dreams for themselves and their teens.

neighbourhoods.name: Rockridge Heights
neighbourhoods.desc: Home to Copperdale High, Rockridge Heights is the town's standard-bearer for academia across generations. It's a beloved school ground for quintessential teen moments and college preparation.

neighbourhoods.name: Prescott Square
neighbourhoods.desc: Named after Copperdale's founder, Jasper Prescott, this town square is a quaint hub for all afterschool hangouts.

neighbourhoods.name: Plumbite Cove
neighbourhoods.desc: Settled on Lake LaSuli sits Plumbite Cove, a once-popular location for its mining of rare gems. After the mines shut down, the town turned this picturesque outlook into a waterfront fairground.

weather: Often cloudy, snowy winters, heat waves in summer

highlights.name: Pier Attractions
highlights.text: Bring friends, family, or even a special someone, to enjoy the thrills of Plumbite Pier's waterfront fairground filled with attractions.

highlights.name: Academia
highlights.text: Learning is always an adventure! Dive into academics or take a break from studying to cheer on the Womp Womps at a Copperdale High afterschool festival.

highlights.name: Town Centre
highlights.text: Home to residents and bustling with teens, come enjoy the tea, trends, and tales of Prescott Square, Copperdale's historic central hub.
